slides.heading: 3 steps that matter most
steps: Ground truth: report, model cards, license, hardware
Know exactly what the model family claims, what this machine can run…
Add independent quality metrics and Blender validation
Score every GLB with tools other than the generator.
Validate against oracles and write the gap report
Lock the recommendation with external checks and document every remaining gap.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: Khronos glTF-Validator CLI reports zero errors on every GLB from the recommended variant.
Blender 4.x headless imports each GLB, resolves all textures, and renders a 4-view turntable without errors.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 6 of 8. Proof. How you know it worked. Khronos glTF-Validator CLI reports zero errors on every GLB from the recommended variant. Blender 4.x headless imports each GLB, resolves all textures, and renders a 4-view turntable without errors.

slides.heading: Rasterizer build fails
paras: ImportError for custom_rasterizer or nvcc errors.
match torch CUDA to nvcc, set CUDA_HOME and TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST, use a matching gcc.
slides.alt: DejaViewed carousel, slide 7 of 8. Biggest failure mode. Rasterizer build fails. Tell: ImportError for custom_rasterizer or nvcc errors. Fix: match torch CUDA to nvcc, set CUDA_HOME and TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST, use a matching gcc.
